## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// One closed loop of boundary half-edges (half-edges whose IFace is -1),
// listed in walk order around the hole.
type BoundaryLoop
    implements IValue
{
    HalfEdges: Array<HalfEdgeIndex>;
}

//==
// ## Corner tables

// Triangle-corner connectivity. Corner c belongs to triangle c / 3; its next
// corner within the triangle is 3 * (c / 3) + ((c + 1) mod 3). Corners[c] is
// the vertex sitting at corner c. Opposites[c] is the corner facing the same
// edge from the adjacent triangle, or -1 when that edge is on the boundary.
type CornerTable
    implements IValue
{
    Corners: Array<VertexIndex>;
    Opposites: Array<CornerIndex>;
}

//==
// # Typed mesh element indices
//
// The zero-based typed index structs that name mesh elements: vertices,
// undirected edges, faces, face corners, half-edges, and volumetric cells. A
// typed index can never be silently confused with another kind, and they all
// share one absence encoding.
// No index type is named a bare `Edge`: an edge index is either
// UndirectedEdgeIndex or HalfEdgeIndex, and the two are not interchangeable
// (the undirected count is half the directed count on a closed manifold).
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Typed indices (Value is zero-based, and -1
// means "none" / "not present").

// A zero-based index of a vertex within a mesh or point set. -1 means "none".
type VertexIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of an undirected edge within an UndirectedEdgeList.
// -1 means "none". The directed counterpart is HalfEdgeIndex.
type UndirectedEdgeIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a face within a mesh. -1 means "none".
type FaceIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a face corner (one vertex slot of one face). For
// triangle meshes, corner c belongs to triangle c / 3 and slot c mod 3.
// -1 means "none".
type CornerIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a half-edge (one directed side of an undirected
// edge). -1 means "none".
type HalfEdgeIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// A zero-based index of a volumetric cell (tetrahedron, hexahedron, voxel
// region) within a cell complex. -1 means "none".
type CellIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}
```
